megan: Quick heads-up — hitting request-id loss when using py-sdk async client + our logging middleware + OTEL. Traces show span but logs don't include request_id :facepalm:

alex: can you paste minimal repro? which sdk version?

megan: SDK 0.8.3, python 3.11, aiohttp. Repro:
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
from redwood.middleware import LoggingMiddleware, OTELMiddleware
client = AsyncClient(api_key="REDACTED")
client.add_middleware(LoggingMiddleware())
client.add_middleware(OTELMiddleware())
await client.chat.create(model="gpt-small", input="hi")
```
Logs show request_id None. OTEL span has trace id.

jordana: suspect contextvar->header bridge isn't run inside our background send task. We enqueue request and header generation uses contextvar that doesn't flow across TaskGroup.

ryan: same bug we saw in old httpx async wrapper. Workaround: set header via request hook that reads trace.get_current_span() synchronously before enqueue. Not ideal.

megan: any quick patch? can we propagate contextvars into the worker?

alex: PR idea: capture contextvars.Context at enqueue time and run send in that context:
```py
import contextvars, asyncio
ctx = contextvars.copy_context()
asyncio.create_task(ctx.run(_send))
```
That should preserve request-id header creation.

jordana: +1. Also need to ensure OTEL instrumentation uses contextvars API not threadlocals. I'll open PR.

ryan: wrote a tiny monkeypatch for now:
```py
orig_create_task = asyncio.create_task
def create_task_with_ctx(coro):
    ctx = contextvars.copy_context()
    return orig_create_task(ctx.run(coro))
asyncio.create_task = create_task_with_ctx
```
Not great but unblocks tests.

ci-bot: test run failed on flakes in tests/test_logging.py::test_request_id_present — showing None header.

megan: thanks all. Jordana, can you link the PR? I'll add a regression test that simulates TaskGroup send scheduling and ensures header preserved.

jordana: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/452 — added context capture + test. also updated docs about middleware ordering.

alex: will review today.

megan: deployed local wheel, tests green. :tada:
